form:FormGroup.label: Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The data type of the field, which controls how its values are entered and compared in rule expressions, e.g. Text, Date, Integer or Boolean.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Controls how values are compared in rule expressions.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: The name of the attribute this field represents in rule expressions. Names must be unique and are not case sensitive.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Must be unique; not case sensitive.
